verdict.rationale: Jan runs local models entirely on-device with 'zero data collection until you say so' and explicit privacy-first design, meaning user data/conversations are not sent to third parties for training by default; local-only operation inherently prevents data being used for AI training. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the privacy claims and no explicit policy statement addressing cloud-model usage data (when users opt into cloud providers) regarding training use.
